notes: Quarter ended 30 June 2026 shareholding pattern (Q1 FY27). The SEBI LODR Reg.31 SHP for Tata Steel for 30 June 2026 is published on the company's investor site (media/26190/tsl-shp-june-30-2026.pdf) but the PDF was not directly decodable in the extract; the values here are from the trendlyne mirror of the same filing (shareholding/1366/TATASTEEL/latest on 30-06-2026). Named promoter group entities are all in the Any Other (Bodies Corporate) sub-category per the SEBI template; Tata Sons Private Limited is the lead promoter holding 31.76% and is the only promoter-entity above 1% as an individual. SCRR denominator 12,485,463,449 is computed as promoter 4,112,694,270 / 32.94% pct and is broadly consistent with the FY26 annual report disclosure of 12,410,485,302 Ordinary Shares dematerialised equal to 99.41% of paid-up capital (paid-up equity shares ~12.485 billion). Jun 2026 SHP is post the 8 Feb 2024 Tinplate Company of India Limited merger and post Jan 2024 Tata Motors Finance Limited merger reflected in the share count.
